clause_6_3_verbatim: U01 §6.3 Collection recovery: bracket terminator is a comment body beginning `]`; trailing comma, spaces and a trailing ordinary comment are accepted structurally. A bracket in a field value is not a terminator. Before a next structural open OR close, stop the damaged block and reprocess that line. Stop before a nonblank non-comment line in line-comment forms. Bare blank/prefix-only lines do not truncate wrapped fields. In wrapped comments stop at the actual wrapper end, next structural opener, section boundary or EOF; record a missing bracket without swallowing another block. A missing wrapper never gives ownership of later headings/code/prose. Record terminated_by = bracket/next_opener/non_comment_line/wrapper_end/section_end/eof plus offending line. At EOF retain the last field. A stray bracket does not open a block or terminate an unrelated span.
candidate_for_this_list: C1+C2 = stop before the next structural @beacon[ / @beacon-close[ line AND before a non-blank line without the opener's comment prefix (line-comment forms)
